rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A Go-based MCP server that bridges AI assistants with Home Assistant smart home systems, providing comprehensive control over IoT devices, automation management, and system monitoring. Offers tools for entity management (querying states, controlling devices), service calls, system insights (domain summaries, error logs), and troubleshooting capabilities. Supports both local stdio transport for desktop AI clients and HTTP transport for remote access, with production-ready features including OAuth authentication, JWT validation, Docker containerization, and Kubernetes deployment via Helm charts.
